title: Soul Trauma
next_chapter_hook: The outline of the second page of the Tianji Record flickered hazily in the Mental Sea, the fragmented runes glimmering like stars—only one step away from glimpsing the sealed truth. Yet Mo Xiansheng's warning thundered in his mind: 'The price of the second page may be your life.'

text.content: In the instant Zhang Shen collapsed to the ground, Chen Ji's fingertips tapped gently on the Tianji Record, and another sacrificial piece appeared on fate's chessboard. Yet his brow furrowed—Ling Yuan, this name proved far more troublesome than he'd anticipated. The Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master, rumored to have long entered seclusion to break through to Transcension, was actually secretly manipulating an Outer Sect Elder to strike at him? 'Interesting.' He murmured softly, cold light flickering in his eyes. The fragment glowed with a ghostly light again, the three-hour premonition passing like a carousel—yet this time, the moment the vision materialized, Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea pierced by ten thousand needles.

dialogue.content: '...No!' Chen Ji clutched his temples abruptly, his knuckles white from strain. The text on the fragment twisted into countless sharp shards, piercing his soul viciously. A fishy sweetness flooded his nose, crimson blood dripping from the corner of his lips, appearing ghastly under the moonlight. Three consecutive days of high-intensity deduction had drained his Heavenly Fate to a critical point, and forcibly probing Ling Yuan's schemes had triggered the Tianji Record's most brutal backlash.

'Chen Ji!' A cry of alarm shattered the night. Su Qingyao had been conducting her routine patrol when she witnessed this usually composed junior brother bleeding from all seven orifices, his form swaying like a candle in the wind. She lunged forward instinctively, catching Chen Ji in her arms just before he collapsed. 'How did you...' Before she could finish, she felt the person in her arms suddenly stiffen, then go limp like a dismantled puppet, eyes closed, breathing so faint it was barely perceptible.

text.content: Su Qingyao's heart tightened sharply. She helped Chen Ji to a nearby stone platform, her delicate fingers pressing against his pulse—chaotic, extremely chaotic. His meridians were flooded with rampaging spiritual energy, as if some invisible force was tearing his soul apart. 'Tianji Record...' She had glimpsed that ancient fragment in Chen Ji's possession during that previous incident, and now connecting it with his bizarre condition, a terrifying suspicion formed in her mind: what exactly was this worthless junior brother trading his life for?

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, wake up!' Su Qingyao patted his cheek gently, her voice难得带了几分慌乱. Yet Chen Ji's eyes remained tightly shut, his brow furrowed into a knot, and even a诡异的紫黑之色 was faintly visible at his brow center. She bit the bullet and channeled her spiritual energy into his body, attempting to stabilize the rampaging force. But the moment her spiritual energy touched the edge of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, a vast and ancient aura violently rebounded, sending her stumbling back several steps.

text.content: Su Qingyao clutched her numb wrist, her face pale. She was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, her cultivation already at Foundation Building Peak—yet even she couldn't penetrate Chen Ji's Mental Sea. What exactly was hidden in there? What alarmed her more was that even after being counterattacked by such formidable power, Chen Ji still gripped that fragment in his arms with white-knuckled intensity, guarding it like something more precious than his life.

dialogue.content: She didn't attempt to probe again. Instead, she quietly straightened Chen Ji and sat cross-legged beside him. 'I don't know what secrets you harbor, nor what you're scheming.' Su Qingyao gazed at that pale-as-paper face, her voice barely a whisper, 'But you've saved Tianqing Sect, again and again... I won't let you die here.' She reached out and gently wiped the blood from the corner of Chen Ji's lips, her eyes flashing with a complex, indecipherable emotion.

text.content: Day one. Chen Ji's breathing fluctuated like a guttering candle. Su Qingyao remained at his side without leaving, channeling spiritual energy every hour. She noticed him murmuring unintelligible names in his coma, occasionally calling out 'Nian'er'—who was that? Day two, the purple-black discoloration at Chen Ji's brow center spread to half his face, resembling evil demon claw marks. Su Qingyao exhausted every method she could think of, yet could only watch helplessly as that uncanny mark eroded his features inch by inch.

dialogue.content: 'You fool...' Su Qingyao's voice carried a hint of choking. She recalled her various interrogations of Chen Ji these past days, her doubts about his废物人设, her investigations into those unbelievable coincidences—so he'd been bearing such a cost all along. She reached out and gently covered Chen Ji's hand gripping the fragment. 'What exactly are you scheming? Is it worth risking your life for?' Only the wind's mourn and the unconscious man's heavy breathing answered her.

text.content: On the third day at dawn, when the first rays of sunlight pierced through the clouds and fell upon Chen Ji's face, his eyelashes finally fluttered slightly. Su Qingyao practically bounced up—three days and three nights without sleep had left faint shadows on her face, yet they did nothing to diminish the concern in her eyes. Chen Ji struggled to open his eyes, his vision first是一片模糊的灰白, then a familiar face came into view—Su Qingyao was leaning over him, eyes bloodshot, haggard yet carrying the relief of one who had narrowly escaped death.

dialogue.content: 'Su... Senior Sister?' Chen Ji tried to prop himself up, only to discover his limbs ached as if stripped of bones, unable to even lift his hand. He wryly smiled, 'This appearance is quite the joke for Senior Sister to witness.' Though he spoke lightly, he still instinctively reached into his chest—the Tianji Record was still there. That ancient fragment lay quietly at his heart, but when his divine sense touched the cover, he suddenly discovered... on the cover, where it had originally been blank, a faint silver rune pattern had now appeared around the edges.

'Don't move!' Su Qingyao pressed his shoulder down, her pretty face slightly clouded. 'You've been unconscious for three days and three nights, your meridians nearly severed—do you want to die from moving around?' Her tone carried some anger, but more was undisguised worry. Chen Ji gazed at her haggard features, his heart briefly startled—this always-cold female cultivator actually showed anxiety and exhaustion he'd never witnessed before. 'Senior Sister, you... stayed with me for three days?'

Su Qingyao turned her face away, her ear tips faintly reddening. 'Enough nonsense. I have no interest in probing your secrets, but you owe me an explanation—why did you end up like this?' Her voice regained some of its usual coolness. 'Also, you kept calling 'Nian'er' in your coma—who is that?' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, then returned to calm. He lowered his eyes, concealing the turmoil flickering in his gaze.

text.content: 'Nian'er... is my younger sister.' Chen Ji's voice was very soft, as if afraid to disturb something. He wasn't lying, but he wasn't telling the whole truth either—Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect as a Heavenly Fate Lock Key, he would never let anyone know. 'She's been missing for a long time.' He paused, forcing a smile. 'Sorry for worrying Senior Sister.' Su Qingyao gazed at that forced smile, feeling an inexplicable pang in her heart, but didn't press further.

Chen Ji probed the Tianji Record with his divine sense once more—this time he saw more clearly—that silver pattern wasn't decorative, but a seal. Above the seal, several fragmented runes faintly emerged, outlining the contours of some ancient Bloodline Formation. And deep within the seal, the outline of the second page flickered tantalizingly, as if one step further would reveal the dust-shrouded truth. However, every time he tried to touch that seal, an intense pain from the depths of his soul would surge forth, reminding him—the time wasn't right yet; forcibly opening it might cost his life.

dialogue.content: Just then, an elderly and ethereal voice echoed悠悠 from the depths of the fragment: 'Opening the second page requires not only Heavenly Fate Value.' Chen Ji's heart shuddered—Mo Xiansheng. The remnant soul guardian dwelling on the first page of the Tianji Record had finally appeared at this moment. 'Oh? What else is needed?' Chen Ji asked in his mind. 'A stronger bloodline.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried deep meaning. 'The Tianji Record chose you not only because of your fate, but also because... the blood of the Chen family flows within you. But this bloodline is far from awakened to its应有的程度.'

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. Chen family bloodline... He'd known since childhood that his origins were mysterious, never having seen his parents, only his younger sister Chen Nian to rely on. If some special bloodline power truly existed within him, why had it never awakened all these years? 'How can I awaken the bloodline?' He pursued in his mind. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before缓缓道: 'After opening the second scroll, you will know. But right now...' His tone shifted abruptly, 'If you insist on forcing this, you may not live to see that day.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's warning echoed in his ears as Chen Ji sank into contemplation. The second page of the Tianji Record was right before him, yet required a stronger bloodline to open. He could risk forcibly breaking through the seal, or choose to recuperate and wait for the opportune moment...

choices.text: Break Through the Seal by Force
choices.description: While the Tianji Record's backlash hasn't fully subsided, forcibly strike the second page's seal with residual power. Extremely high risk, may cause Soul Trauma or even permanent damage, but if successful, will gain the ancient secret techniques contained on the second page.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 50 Heavenly Fate Value, Soul Trauma worsens
choices.visible_reward: Second page of Tianji Record partially unsealed, gains 'Tianji Eye · Initial Glimpse' skill
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk: may fall unconscious for even longer, if Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero will trigger fatal flag

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, gathering all his remaining spiritual energy within his divine sense, launching a desperate assault on the second page's seal. In that instant, thunder roared in his Mental Sea, that silver seal quivered violently, countless ancient runes coiled around his soul like chains. Agonizing pain struck, Chen Ji clenched his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, a mouthful of blood spraying three feet away—but a manic gleam flickered in his eyes.

choices.description: Heeding Mo Xiansheng's warning, temporarily abandon the assault on the second page. Use this time to recover the soul damaged from overusing the Tianji Record, while secretly investigating Ling Yuan's schemes, seeking opportunities for bloodline awakening.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon the power enhancement from the second page
choices.visible_reward: Soul Trauma gradually recovers, unlocks 'Heart-Nourishing Art'辅助技能, prepares for bloodline awakening
choices.risk_hint: Low risk: Ling Yuan may take new actions during this period

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his divine sense, a self-deprecating smile curling his lips. 'Mo Xiansheng is right—haste makes waste.' He leaned against the stone platform, closing his eyes to regulate his breathing. Beside him, Su Qingyao's eyes flickered with relief—this junior brother, though shrouded in mysteries, at least knew轻重. She produced a healing elixir and handed it over: 'Take this first. The rest can wait.'

choices.text: Confide Partial Truth to Su Qingyao
choices.description: Given Su Qingyao's three-day-and-night vigil and interrogations, Chen Ji decides to reveal part of the truth—about the Tianji Record's existence and its price, but not mentioning Chen Nian or Ling Yuan's conspiracy. This is to earn her trust and covert assistance.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Establish initial trusting relationship with Su Qingyao, she will become an important aid during your recovery
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk: Su Qingyao may report this matter to the Sect

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long moment before finally sighing softly. He took out that fragment from his chest, slowly unfurling it before Su Qingyao. 'Since Senior Sister watched over me for three days, we share a bond.' His voice was soft. 'This item is called the Tianji Record—it can glimpse three hours into the future, but each use...' He pointed to his haggard face. 'Requires a price.' Su Qingyao gazed at that yellowed fragment, shock flickering in her eyes, yet she didn't reach out to touch it.

However, regardless of the choice, the current predicament was real—his body was nearly depleted, Heavenly Fate Value halved, yet the Tianji Record's shackles tightened ever more. Ling Yuan's shadow hung like a sword above his head, ready to fall at any moment. Chen Ji closed his eyes, calculating silently in his heart: this round, he lost due to being too aggressive. But as long as he was alive, there would still be chances for a comeback. 'I've noted it...' He murmured softly, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth. 'Ling Yuan, wait for me.'

dialogue.content: 'What are you saying?' Su Qingyao heard that murmur, her brow creasing. Chen Ji opened his eyes, offering her a weak smile: 'Nothing, just... some accounts always need settling.' His gaze passed over Su Qingyao's shoulder, toward the distant horizon where a faint glow was gradually brightening—that was the beginning of a new day, and also the starting point of his path of revenge. Though the Tianji Record's shackles were tight, Chen Ji's chess game had never truly held a dead position.

text.content: Three days of coma, the price was heavy, yet it also let him see clearly many things—Su Qingyao's guardianship wasn't entirely out of duty; those three days and nights of unwavering vigil clearly concealed some emotion she herself hadn't yet noticed. And though the second page's seal of the Tianji Record was formidable, it also revealed a crucial piece of information: the Chen family bloodline was his true trump card. 'It seems,' Chen Ji calculated in his heart, a resolute gleam flashing in his eyes, 'it's time to investigate my own origins.' The outline of the Tianji Record's second page flickered hazily, just one final step away from manifesting...
